item: Every Help language tells its reader the text was written by AI (R721)
key_paths: src/static/app-settings.js; src/static/locales/*.json; docs/i18n/*/*.md; scripts/native_review_queue.py; tests/help_banner_node_test.js; tests/test_help_banner.py
summary: Native review of Help is dropped. The Help reader's banner now opens with one sentence, x12, for every reader including English: This help text was written by AI and may contain mistakes. A translated document adds its language, the translated-of-total heading figure and that the English original is authoritative. The old Machine-drafted ... improve it on the project page wording was replaced, not kept beside it; the drafts' opening comments say written by AI instead of not yet reviewed by a native speaker; the native review queue no longer lists Help documents. 0.6 gate row E closed.
